about: R18 guide route (R19: the Pewter heal and the training step use the worst-case Brock line of tools/r19_ready.py): power-on to Brock, one numbered step list (RestedXP style). Read by tools/r18_guide.py. Each step: phase (story part, from RAM), objective (one line), target (waypoint: map, optional x/y or row; or a special walk), action (keys at the waypoint), done and skip checks (all must hold; 'a|b' = either; '!' = not). Facts: pokered map objects (data/maps/objects/*.asm) and scripts (PalletTown.asm y==1 trigger, OaksLab.asm balls (6-8,3), ViridianMart.asm parcel on entry, PewterGym.asm trainer (3,6) facing right).

steps.objective: Start a NEW GAME: A past the logo and title, A on NEW GAME.
Read Oak's talk; pick the ready-made names (RED, then BLUE).
Go down the stairs of your room (7,1).
Leave the house by the door at the bottom (2,7)/(3,7).
Walk to the top row of Pallet Town (10,1): Oak stops you and takes you to his lab.
Pick SQUIRTLE, the middle ball (7,3): stand at (7,4), face up, A, then YES.
Walk down to row 6: your rival challenges you. Fight with TACKLE.
Leave the lab and walk north out of Pallet Town onto Route 1.
Walk north up Route 1 to Viridian City.
Enter the Viridian Mart (blue roof, door (29,19)): the clerk gives you Oak's Parcel.
Take the Parcel back: walk south out of Viridian City onto Route 1.
Walk south down Route 1 to Pallet Town.
Enter Oak's lab (door (12,11), the big building at the bottom).
Give the Parcel to Oak (5,2): stand at (5,3), face up, A.
Read Oak's text until you get the Pokedex.
Leave the lab and walk north out of Pallet Town onto Route 1.
Walk north up Route 1 to Viridian City.
Buy 1 Antidote (100) at the Viridian Mart (door (29,19)): Weedles in the forest poison.
Heal at the Viridian Pokemon Center (door (23,25)) before the long forest leg.
Walk north out of Viridian City onto Route 2.
Walk up Route 2 to the forest's south gate house (door (3,43)).
Walk through the gate house (exit at the top) into Viridian Forest.
Cross Viridian Forest to the north exit (1,0)/(2,0). Bug catchers give experience.
Walk through the north gate house (exit at the top) to Route 2.
Heal at the Pewter Pokemon Center (door (13,25)) before the gym: HP too low for Brock.
Not ready for Brock yet: train in the Route 2 grass just south of Pewter until ready.
Walk north on Route 2 into Pewter City.
Enter Pewter Gym: door (16,17), walk up into it from (16,18).
Walk the left bypass to (4,2), below Brock; it skips the trainer at (3,6).
Talk to Brock (4,1): up a a*. Use BUBBLE every turn (Water beats Rock).
